critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering bug fixed: PATCH /api/courses/{id}/slides/reorder was unreachable because PATCH /slides/{slide_id} matched first. FastAPI declaration order is critical for shared prefixes — would have made the new SortableList UI fail silently with 422.

MailService stub mode persists every send to OutboxMessage with status='STUB' + attachments JSON (filename only — PDF bytes are NOT stored, only the metadata). Confirmed via outbox UI showing '1 file' indicator.

InvitationService correctly normalizes email to lowercase on store (caused my initial test failure). The accept endpoint issues access+refresh cookies AND returns access_token in body when configured, and returns roles=['INSTRUCTOR'] via normalize_role_names — verified end-to-end.
Lead capture (extras.py) properly guards lifecycle_stage: existing LEARNER on learner@ifpi.org keeps LEARNER even when posted via /api/leads — verified in test.

Cert email is correctly gated by cert_is_new — a second /complete with the SAME (user, course) does not create a second outbox row. The try/except around mail send means PDF/SMTP failures never break /complete — good resilience.
Embed.js Content-Type is 'application/javascript' (not 'text/javascript' as the spec mentioned) — both are valid per RFC 9239; modern browsers accept both. No action needed.
PDF logo fallback verified — setting org.logo_url to an unreachable URL still produces a valid %PDF (graceful fallback to wordmark).

rca of the issue: Route ordering: FastAPI evaluates @router decorators in declaration order. PATCH /{course_id}/slides/{slide_id} was declared at line 193, while PATCH /{course_id}/slides/reorder was at line 442. Any request to /slides/reorder matched the dynamic {slide_id} route first → Pydantic tried to coerce 'reorder' to int → 422 with 'Input should be a valid integer'. Fix: declare the static-path route (`/slides/reorder`) BEFORE the dynamic-path route (`/slides/{slide_id}`). Verified by re-running test_slides_reorder.
